environmentVariables.description: Your API key — one credential, two names: the console mints it as an API key (ship-...), and this setting carries it as the token. Free at https://my.shipstatic.com/api-key. Optional: without it, deploys behave like the hosted endpoint (public, claim URL, 3-day expiry). With it, deployments are permanent, the full toolset (custom domains, listing, account-tied ops) unlocks, and you get bigger limits.
environmentVariables.name: SHIP_TOKEN
